body.p: It was not very long ago. Once a man went to the river for fishing. He bagged some fishes. He went [back] home. On the middle of his way he saw a man sitting on a log. He came closer to him. That one waved with his hands. When the man came closer, he [the sitting one] asked: "Who gives the fish?" The man says: "God". That one said: "I am the one you are talking about. You will always bag [something], if you don't tell anyone that you met me. If you tell somebody, it will be bad for you". "I won't tell anybody". Then he went off from him to his tent. When he looked back, the man on the log had disappeared. Having come home, he threw his fishes to the place for the housewife. Having thrown [it] he went through the tents: "Why do you use to say that there is no God? I met God". Some time passed, the man became dumb. After the man had become dumb, he began to speak again(?). Since then people started to remember God. My story has ended.
